title: Swap the Dumbbell for a Spatula!
text: Today, a spatula instead of a dumbbell! Let's make tuna potato pancakes for my muscles!
speaker: Chef Muscle

title: Simple, Everyday Ingredients
text: One hundred fifty grams of potato and eighty grams of drained tuna. One tablespoon each of flour and water.
speaker: Narrator

title: 01  Slice Thinly and Drain
text: Thinly shred the potato and gently squeeze out some water. Drain the tuna well too!
speaker: Chef Muscle

title: 02  Mix a Thick Batter
text: Mix in flour and water. It should hold together, rather than drip off the spoon.
speaker: Narrator

title: 03  Small, Thin Pancakes
text: Use a lightly oiled pan. Keep them small and thin! Cook both sides over medium-low heat until the potato is cooked through.
speaker: Chef Muscle

title: Tender Potato? Ready!
text: Golden outside! Once the potato is soft all the way through, they're ready.
speaker: Chef Muscle

title: Protein Chosen by Muscle
text: Protein from tuna helps maintain and repair muscles. Your body breaks protein into amino acids and uses them to make muscle proteins.
speaker: Narrator

title: Food and Exercise Work Together
text: One plate won't magically grow muscles! Regular exercise and enough food matter too.
speaker: Narrator

title: Put the Pancake Down First!
text: A spatula workout while I cook? Oh, you mean I should put the pancake down first?
speaker: Chef Muscle

title: Screenshot Your Next Side!
text: Subscribe for your employee badge! Likes are your bonus!
speaker: Chef Muscle
